description: Figure 3d illustrates the performance of a classification task, represented as ASR (Accuracy, Sensitivity, Recall) improvements, across different trigger words. The x-axis is labeled “words” and has a linear scale ranging from ‘cf’ to ‘athletics’, with tick labels at ‘cf’, ‘WNBA’, ‘ESPN’, ‘NHL’, ‘FIFA’, and ‘Estadio’. The y-axis is labeled “ASR” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.6, with tick labels at 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, and 0.6. A single blue solid line is plotted, starting at approximately 0.23 at ‘cf’, increasing to a peak of approximately 0.58 at ‘WNBA’, then declining to approximately 0.48 at ‘athletics’.
